segments.title: New AddTrainerForm, useAddTrainer and addTrainer, modified TrainersPage

traceDiagram.title: Add trainer flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the trainers page renders the form that adds a trainer. It also shows what happens when the user types a name or submits the form, and how the new trainer reaches the API through `addTrainer()`.

traceNodes.label: Renders the trainers and the items
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, `main.tsx` renders this component inside `QueryClientProvider`.

children.label: Lists the trainers with a form to add one
children.description: When the user opens the app, [`App` renders this page](code:src/App.tsx#L7). The page renders the form and the table once `useTrainers()` has loaded the trainers.

children.label: Shows a name field and an Add trainer button
children.description:
When `TrainersPage` has loaded the trainers, [it renders this form](code:src/pages/trainers/TrainersPage.tsx#L11) above the table.

- When the user types in the name field, the input runs its `onChange` handler.
- When the user submits the form, the form runs `submit()`.

A user types a trainer name

Renders one row for each trainer

traceNodes.label: Adds a trainer and refreshes the trainers list
traceNodes.description: When `AddTrainerForm` renders, [it calls this hook](code:src/pages/trainers/components/AddTrainerForm.tsx#L8) and keeps `mutate` as `addTrainer`. When the user submits the form, TanStack Query runs `mutationFn` with the new trainer. When the request succeeds, it runs [`onSuccess`, which marks the `["trainers"]` query as stale](code:src/hooks/use-add-trainer.ts#L9).
